Limited Liability FTC 3650

FTC 3650 Limited Liability is a school-based team at La Jolla Country Day School that builds in-house robots with a primary focus on autonomous performance and reliability.

Founded in 2009.

Team photo at league meet.

Focus

Engineering first

Student-led, faculty-mentored work focused on autonomous performance and reliability.

Design & build

All robot systems are designed and built in-house. We use SolidWorks for CAD and build custom robots by hand.

Autonomous & testing

We program in Java using Android Studio, emphasize autonomous routines, and use simulation with a trajectory model to optimize projectile angles.

Practice & reliability

Driver practice runs on a full practice field. We track iterations internally and focus on repeatable performance.
